scope: Six Indonesian Google Play descriptions from the same Easybrain, Oakever, Brainium, Andoku, Guru and GamoVation international samples. All retrieved with hl=id. Not an Indonesian market/download ranking or proof of Indonesia-exclusive text.
method: NFC, lowercase, whitespace collapse, curly apostrophes normalized to straight apostrophes and dash variants to hyphen. Exact contiguous phrases delimited by Unicode letters/digits. Accents, hyphenation, inflections and synonyms remain distinct. Body between Tentang game ini and Diupdate pada, including public short description if supplied. Excludes titles, tags, reviews, screenshots, related-app cards and linked sites; literal URLs/emails within body remain part of sampled text. Nested rows can overlap. Cache/region can affect the sample; a cached older listing is not a verified latest version. Full competitor prose is not persisted.

sources.retrievalNote: Opened cached page reports 29 Sep 2025 update; sampled as retrieved, not asserted to be the latest listing.

terminologySources.use: Indonesian publisher rules read directly: baris, kolom, area, sel and 1–9. Used for meanings only; source typos not adopted.
